shots.prompt: 2D cel animation key frame, flat colour fields, hard-edged shadows, constant line width, clean black line art, overcast grey light. Seen from behind a mass of riders: helmets, shoulders and horse rumps close the frame edges, rank behind rank, tall banners over them, dust rolling between the horses. Ahead, across the plain, the enemy line stands in a long dark row. A rider in a dark red cloak, seen from behind, rides in the middle of them.
